data.title: Combo List Iteration Pattern
data.description: Detects sequential username patterns typical of combo list iteration during credential stuffing attacks. Attackers feed sorted credential lists into stuffing tools, producing login attempts where usernames appear in alphabetical or near-alphabetical order with minimal timing variation between attempts, a pattern never seen in organic user behavior.

detection.condition: selection | count(distinct username) by source_ip > 15 and stddev(inter_event_time) by source_ip < 500ms

falsepositives: Automated batch user provisioning systems that test accounts sequentially
QA test suites running ordered account validation during deployments
